message: Transistor is a podcast hosting platform that publishes audio and video shows to the major listening apps and, on one paid account, lets an agency run more than one podcast without a per-podcast charge. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Introduce Transistor as a podcast host where a single account can carry more than one show at no extra per-podcast charge, publishing each feed to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube and other apps, with per-episode download analytics in the dashboard; the single next step is starting the 14-day free trial and creating a show. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
